/**
 * @file parser.h
 * @brief Parses recipes.
 */

#ifndef PARSER_H
#define PARSER_H

#include <stddef.h>

// Sits above nothing: a blank line follows.

/** The largest recipe the parser reads. */
#define PARSER_LIMIT 4096

/// A parsed point.
typedef struct point {
    int x; ///< The horizontal position.
    /** The vertical position. */
    int y;
} point_t;

/** The kinds of block. */
enum kind {
    /** Plain text. */
    KIND_TEXT,
    KIND_CODE, /* a trailing comment */
};

/**
 * Parses the input.
 *
 * \param text the text to read
 * \return the number of blocks
 */
int parse(const char *text);

// A plain comment on a variable.
static int count = 0;

//! Frees a parser.
void parser_free(void *parser)
{
    /* Inside the function. */
    (void)parser;
}

#endif /* PARSER_H */
